subject: Fraud & Scams
title: Time Pressure as a Weapon
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Time Pressure as a Weapon.

hook.text: 'This offer expires in 15 minutes.' Legitimate deals don't have countdown timers.

buildup.text: Scammers create artificial urgency because careful thinking is the enemy of fraud.

discovery.text: Under time pressure, the brain switches from analytical thinking to emotional reaction.

twist.text: Real opportunities allow due diligence. Only scams demand instant decisions.

climax.text: The moment someone says 'act now or lose it,' your risk of being scammed spikes dramatically.

punchline.text: Urgency is a red flag dressed as an opportunity.

quiz.question: Why do scammers create time pressure?
options: It prevents victims from thinking carefully
It makes the offer seem exclusive
